# APEX Skills

[![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-GitHub%20Pages-blue)](https://aws-samples.github.io/sample-apex-skills/) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/apex-skills)](https://registry.npmjs.org/apex-skills) [![License: MIT-0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT--0-green)](../../LICENSE)

Agent skills for AWS platform engineering on Amazon EKS and Amazon ECS, for Claude Code, Kiro CLI, Codex and any harness that reads the [Agent Skills standard](https://agentskills.io/).

## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| Skills | 28 (13 EKS, 9 ECS, 6 general) |
| Vendored from upstream | 5 ([provenance](#provenance)) |
| Entry point | `/apex` router skill |
| AWS DevOps Agent ports | 6 |
| Hands-on examples | 2 |
| Installer | `apex-skills` 1.3.0 on npm |
| License | MIT-0 |

## Install

| Harness | Command | Then |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code, Kiro CLI | `npx apex-skills@1.3.0` | type `/apex` with your request |
| Claude Code (manual) | `cp -r skills/* ~/.claude/skills/` | type `/apex` with your request |
| Kiro CLI (manual) | `cp -r skills/* ~/.kiro/skills/` | type `/apex`, or ask for apex by name |
| Codex (manual) | `cp -r skills/* ~/.agents/skills/` | type `$apex` with your request |

Manual installs run from a clone of this repo. Prerequisites, flags and uninstall: [installer README](../installer/README.md).

## Repository layout

| Path | Holds |
|---|---|
| `skills/` | The skills, one directory each |
| `skills/apex/` | The router skill and its runbooks |
| `rules/` | Optional agent guardrails ([AGENTS.md](../../rules/AGENTS.md)) |
| `examples/` | Deployable labs with planted issues |
| `devops-agent/` | [AWS DevOps Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/devopsagent/latest/userguide/) ports |
| `misc/` | Tooling, installer, evals, docs site |
